source.method: sparql:SELECT ?item ?itemLabel ?article ?sitelinks ?hostLabel WHERE { { SELECT ?item (SAMPLE(?h) AS ?host) WHERE { ?item wikibase:sitelinks ?sl . FILTER(?sl >= 6) ?item wdt:P31/wdt:P279* wd:Q5398426 . ?item wdt:P136/wdt:P279* wd:Q182415 . ?item wdt:P371 ?h . ?h wdt:P31 wd:Q5 } GROUP BY ?item HAVING(COUNT(DISTINCT ?h) = 1) } hint:Prior hint:runFirst true . OPTIONAL { ?article schema:about ?item ; schema:isPartOf <https://en.wikipedia.org/> . } ?item wikibase:sitelinks ?sitelinks .
